<h1 class="inbl">Akihito YAMADA <img src="/img/logo/drapeaux/petit/jap.png" alt="Japan Flag" /> 40 years, Winger</h1>
<div id="bio">
<div class="photo">
<img src="/img/joueurs/default.png" alt="Photo Akihito YAMADA" />
</div>
<div class="bio">
<h2>Bio</h2>
<p>
<b>Akihito YAMADA</b> is a 40-year-old <a href="/players/japan">Japanese rugby player</a>
standing at 1.81&nbsp;m tall (5&nbsp;ft 11&nbsp;in)
and
weighing in at 90&nbsp;kg
(14&nbsp;st 2.42&nbsp;lb; 198.42&nbsp;lb)
, who currently plays for <a href="/club/kyushu/">Kyūshu Kyuden Voltex</a> in Japan as winger.
<div class="grid-3 txtcenter mts">
<div>
<span class="gras">Nationality #1</span>
<br/>
<img src="/img/logo/drapeaux/petit/jap.png" alt="Drapeau Japan" /> Japan
</div>
<div>
<span class="gras">Sporting nationality</span>
<br/>
<img src="/img/logo/drapeaux/petit/jap.png" alt="Drapeau Japan" /> Japan
</div>
</div>
</p>
</div>
<div class="parcours">
<h2>Career</h2>
<ul>
<li>Sunwolves (2015 - 2019)</li>
<li>Urayasu D-Rocks (2019 - 2020)</li>
<li>Seattle Seawolves (2020 - 2021)</li>
<li>Urayasu D-Rocks (2021 - 2022)</li>
<li>Kyūshu Kyuden Voltex (2022 - 2026)</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
